name: vending-machine
description: A one-press vending machine: nearest player in range with an emerald pays one emerald, receives bread, stock decrements, and the shop resets. Sold-out state is visible in the action bar.

blocks.command: execute as @a[r=4,hasitem={item=emerald,quantity=1..},c=1] run scoreboard players set @s shop 1
blocks.note: c=1 keeps it to one buyer per press

blocks.command: execute if score fb_stock shop matches 1..
blocks.note: pure condition gate: checks stock before payment
fails if the player no longer has the emerald
unconditional: clears stale flags even when payment failed

blocks.command: execute if score fb_stock shop matches 0 run title @a actionbar §cSold out

tests: Buy with 1 emerald: emerald leaves inventory, 1 bread arrives, stock 10 -> 9.
Buy with 0 emeralds: nothing happens, stock unchanged, no error message.
Buy at stock 0: no payment, 'Sold out' appears.
Two players next to the machine: only the nearest one is charged per press.
Press restock: stock returns to 10 and the action bar confirms.
Drop an emerald after pressing: the clear step must fail and the bread must not be given.
notes: The conditional pipeline is the all-or-nothing guarantee: stock gate -> clear -> give -> stock decrement.
cleanup and sold_out are unconditional so they run even when a conditional step failed.
c=1 is intentional; remove it only if you want every nearby player to buy at once, and then fix stock accounting.
